title: Raw path language
statement: The language consists of Boolean lists $x$ for which there are natural numbers $n,s,t$ and a Boolean list $M$ of length $n^2$ such that $s,t<n$, $x$ is the path encoding determined by $n,M,s,t$, and there is a finite sequence of raw-adjacency steps from $s$ to $t$.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers n, s, and t
Boolean list M has length n²
x equals the path encoding determined by n, M, s, and t
s reaches t by zero or more raw-adjacency steps
caveat: The definition of the path encoding is not included in the supplied material, so its precise construction cannot be stated.
